text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
I found two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers in Moss's notes:

1. **#PD-4492**: from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md). Thea Ramaswell opened it on 4 Oct 2025. Drivers at the Eau Claire yard, Dock Doors 14–18, weren't getting their SMS bay assignments. Support applied a patch that evening, and Thea confirmed the next morning's 04:00 shift checked in without problems.
2. **#4419**: from "Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)" (teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md). Also opened by Thea. The gatehouse barcode scanners weren't reading trailer tags at Door 14 during the third shift. The note says it was escalated to tier-2 support for scanner firmware testing. Since the note has no date, I can't tell whether that's still the current status.

I also checked Moss's other two North notes (the 9/14/2025 pipeline digest and the 3/23/2026 renewal check-in). They mention Quarrendon but don't give any ticket numbers. The ticket numbers in Moss's Central notes (#4409, #4412, FR-882) are for Marrow accounts, not Quarrendon.

Marcus has a public note about Quarendon Freightways (spelled with one "r"). That's a different company and not one of our customers, and the note has no tickets anyway.

I only searched the notes you can open yourself. There's no Quarrendon account folder (accounts/) among the files you can access, so the full ticket list may be longer than what Moss wrote down.
